title: Private Wicker Park and Bucktown Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is your chance to tour the coolest of Chicago's 77 neighborhoods alongside a funny, knowledgeable local guide. You've done the Loop; now it's time to see a whole different side of the city. 

The tour has 2 options:
Wicker Park and Bucktown - faster pace, 2.5 miles of walking. 
Wicker Park only - slower pace, 1.5 miles of walking
